### Headline summary
- DeepSeek open-sourced its Super-Agent coding prototype and released an enhanced coding agent to rival Anthropic. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-01/deepseek-drops-enhanced-coding-agent-with-aim-to-rival-anthropic), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261101/p2#a261101p2))
- Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman stated that developing conscious AI is reckless and cautioned against building conscious superintelligence. ([Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/mustafa-suleyman-microsoft-ai-consciousness-2026-11))
- Data centers have emerged as a significant political topic in the US midterm elections, with conversations about them dominating events in places like Brooklyn. ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/31/data-centers-are-now-a-midterm-issue-even-in-brooklyn/), [Artificial Intelligence](https://futurism.com/artificial-intelligence/fox-news-media-data-center-propaganda-coverage))

### DeepSeek releases enhanced coding agent
DeepSeek open-sourced its Super-Agent coding prototype and dropped an enhanced coding agent with the aim of rivaling Anthropic. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-01/deepseek-drops-enhanced-coding-agent-with-aim-to-rival-anthropic), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261101/p2#a261101p2), [MarkTechPost](https://www.marktechpost.com/2026/11/01/deepseek-dsh-superagent-router-worker-coding-agent/))

### OpenAI updates ChatGPT features and security
OpenAI consolidated ChatGPT modes and restricted paid accounts, while a separate report noted that a ChatGPT share link leaked private conversations. ([DEV Community](https://dev.to/randomchaos/a-chatgpt-share-link-leaked-your-private-conversations-4oia), [THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/openais-upcoming-chat-and-work-merger-in-chatgpt-signals-the-end-of-all-you-can-prompt-pricing/), [THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/openai-is-steering-chatgpt-users-toward-more-paid-usage/))

### Microsoft AI chief says AI is not conscious and we should keep it that way
Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman cautioned against building conscious superintelligence on X. Stephen Brashear/Getty Images Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman said developing conscious AI is "reckless." That's not exactly a hot take, but many AI researchers believe it's possible. ([Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/mustafa-suleyman-microsoft-ai-consciousness-2026-11))

### Data centers become a major US midterm election issue
Data centers have emerged as a significant political topic in the US midterm elections, with conversations about them dominating events in places like Brooklyn. This political backlash is evident in media coverage, where Fox News has seen a ratings hit while tripling its pro-data center coverage. ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/31/data-centers-are-now-a-midterm-issue-even-in-brooklyn/), [Artificial Intelligence](https://futurism.com/artificial-intelligence/fox-news-media-data-center-propaganda-coverage))

### New AI crawling opt-out standard supported by major labs
Google, Anthropic, and other companies announced support for a new standard allowing websites to express AI training preferences and opt out of crawling. ([Hacker News (AI tag)](https://openai.com/index/helping-websites-express-ai-training-preferences/), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://siliconangle.com/2026/10/30/google-anthropic-and-others-to-support-new-ai-crawling-opt-out-standard/))

### Judge says xAI must face NAACP lawsuit on data center pollution
The legal battle revolves around the AI company's operations in southern Memphis. ([Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2303462/judge-says-xai-must-face-naacp-lawsuit-on-data-center-pollution/))

### National Grid to site biggest substation in UK near planned Teesside datacentre
New electricity generating capacity would enable north-east to attract investment for large-scale AI infrastructure National Grid has taken a step towards building Britain’s biggest electricity substation on Teesside, which could supply power to a vast neighbouring datacentre as the UK races to exp… ([Artificial intelligence (AI)](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/nov/01/national-grid-to-site-biggest-substation-on-teesside-near-planned-ai-datacentre))

### AI Is Finding a Flood of Bugs, and Silicon Valley Is Rushing to Fix Them
A.I. has uncovered a horde of software flaws, which engineers are racing to fix before they can be exploited and abused by hackers. ([NYT > Technology](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/28/technology/silicon-valley-bugs-ai.html))
